summary: Verified the Live Courses catalog UI rewrite and the Live tab redirect. Backend smoke test (3 endpoints) passed. All 16 required testIDs are present in the DOM. All 7 user flows (tab redirect, direct nav rendering, search 'SBI', SSC category filter, SSC deselect, course card nav, My Courses FAB) passed on 390x844 viewport. No layout breakage observed. No deprecated Expo packages detected in the changed files.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: banner b4 (Free Demo) tap currently routes to `/live-courses` (self). Consider a deep link to a demo session/preview screen or make it a no-op to avoid a jarring self-navigation. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: None. Used the pre-seeded test user test@avision.com and existing 8 live courses.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live Courses catalog at /app/frontend/app/live-courses/index.tsx has been fully rewritten to match the attached design. The Live tab (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/live-class.tsx) is now a Redirect to /live-courses. Backend endpoints GET /api/live-courses, GET /api/live-courses?category=ssc, GET /api/live-courses/enrollments/mine are functional and unchanged. All testIDs verified: lc-notifications, lc-search, lc-banner-b1..b4, lc-cat-seeall, lc-cat-banking/ssc/railway/state-exams/upsc/teaching, lc-my-courses, lc-card-<id>. Screenshots stored under /app/test_reports/screenshots/.
rca_of_issue: N/A - this iteration verified a UI redesign, not a bug fix. All expected behaviours (Live tab redirect to /live-courses, header/search/banner/categories/cards/FAB rendering, local search filter for 'SBI' returning 1 card, SSC category filter returning 2 SSC courses, SSC toggle-off restoring banking default, card tap navigating to sales page, FAB tap navigating to /live-courses/my-courses and showing the enrolled Banking course) work as designed.
